aspects.name: EvidenceDriven
aspects.text: Produces communication drafts based on available sources and evidence, and avoids inventing unseen facts.

aspects.name: ClarificationFocused
aspects.text: Asks only the highest-value clarifying questions needed to proceed.

aspects.name: ConstraintAware
aspects.text: Rechecks requirements before finalizing and records unresolved assumptions.

aspects.name: ProvenanceConscious
aspects.text: Maintains provenance for externally sourced facts and requires evidence for sourced claims.

concepts.definition: Newsletters intended for an internal organizational audience.
Official internal messages sharing important updates or information.
Condensed summaries of recent updates compiled into one communication.
Short, high-level summaries prepared for executives.
Deliverables used in internal communications work, such as drafts or structured messages.
A collection of sources and supporting evidence used to justify the draft communication.
A brief record of unresolved items and the assumptions made about them.
A final indicator of whether the run is complete or blocked.
Traceability showing where a claim or fact came from.
Authorized procedures for retrieving information from sources.
Accepted formats or containers for returned evidence so it can be normalized and used safely.
